height.$description: A small button's height. It follows the density setting through size/control-sm.

gap.$description: Between a small button's icon and its label.

padding-inline.$description: Beside a small button's label, before the density step (--but-density-padding), which every app adds.

icon-only-padding-inline.$description: Beside a small button's icon when it has no label. The button is 2px wider than tall.

height.$description: A medium button's height, for a row of buttons in a dense header or beside a small segmented control. It follows the density setting through size/control-md.

gap.$description: Between a medium button's icon and its label.

padding-inline.$description: Beside a medium button's label, before the density step (--but-density-padding), which every app adds. A small segmented control's segments take the same, so the two line up in a row.

icon-only-padding-inline.$description: Beside a medium button's icon when it has no label. The button is 2px wider than tall.

height.$description: A button's height. It follows the density setting through size/control.

gap.$description: Between a button's icon and its label.

padding-inline.$description: Beside a button's label, before the density step (--but-density-padding), which every app adds.

icon-only-padding-inline.$description: Beside a button's icon when it has no label. The button is square.
